project_type: Greenfield server-rendered SaaS web application (PokeOps - Pokemon TCG Seller Operating System). Multi-user inventory/pricing/listing/order management dashboard.
language: TypeScript (compiled to ES2022 ESM JavaScript), server-rendered HTML + vanilla CSS/JS for the frontend.
build_system: Global TypeScript compiler `tsc` (TypeScript v7.0.2, the Go-based tsgo). NO bundler. Source in src/ compiles to dist/. Run npm scripts via a package.json whose scripts call tsc/node directly. Do NOT rely on `npm install` - the npm registry is FORBIDDEN (403) in this sandbox. package.json must have ZERO dependencies and ZERO devDependencies.
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (`node --test`) with node:assert. Test files named *.test.ts compiled alongside src, or *.test.mjs. Tests run against compiled dist output or via tsc first.
build_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm run build   (which runs: tsc -p tsconfig.json)
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS; cd /projects/sandbox/PSA && npm test   (which runs: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/**/*.test.js  OR node --test after build)
verification_instructions: 1) unset NODE_OPTIONS in every shell (the env var points to a nonexistent proxy-bootstrap.js and breaks node/npm/tsc otherwise). 2) Run `npm run build` and confirm tsc exits 0. 3) Run `npm test` and confirm all node:test cases pass. 4) Run `npm run seed` to populate the SQLite demo DB. 5) Start server with `npm start`, curl http://localhost:PORT/ and key pages (/dashboard, /inventory, /scan, /listings) and confirm HTML 200 responses render KPIs/tables. 6) Confirm server starts with no runtime errors in stdout.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is generated by tsc (gitignored). data/pokeops.db is the generated SQLite database created by the seed script (gitignored). No checked-in snapshots. Regenerate DB with `npm run seed`.
setup_instructions: No install step is possible or needed (zero dependencies). Setup = clone, `unset NODE_OPTIONS`, `npm run build`, `npm run seed`, `npm start`. Node v22.23.2 provides node:sqlite (experimental, use --no-warnings or accept the ExperimentalWarning) and node:http natively.
environment_constraints: NETWORK = INTEGRATIONS_ONLY. npm registry access returns HTTP 403 through the proxy - NO packages can be installed. The stack MUST use only Node.js built-in modules (node:http, node:sqlite, node:crypto, node:test, node:fs, node:path, node:url) plus the globally-available `tsc`. CRITICAL: the shell env sets NODE_OPTIONS=--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js which does NOT exist and makes every node/npm/tsc call crash; every build/test/run command MUST `unset NODE_OPTIONS` first (put this in npm scripts is not enough since npm itself is node - unset in the shell before invoking, and/or the scripts can prefix commands). node:sqlite emits an ExperimentalWarning; suppress with NODE_OPTIONS unset + `--no-warnings` flag on node invocations where output cleanliness matters. No real external APIs (eBay, price feeds, CV/LLM) are reachable at runtime - these MUST be mock/stub implementations behind interfaces.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md (empty repo). Conventions established by this plan: TypeScript strict mode, ESM ("type":"module"), rootDir=src outDir=dist, explicit rootDir set in tsconfig (TS7 requires it). Commit only source, package.json, tsconfig.json, README.md, .gitignore, and the .agents task state. Do NOT commit dist/, data/*.db, or node_modules.
key_patterns: Layered architecture: (1) src/db (schema + migrations + DatabaseSync connection singleton), (2) src/repositories (typed data access per entity), (3) src/services (business logic: pricing engine, single-vs-bulk classifier, listing generator, SKU generator, recognition pipeline, seller assistant - each behind an interface in src/services/interfaces), (4) src/server (http router, middleware, session auth), (5) src/views (server-rendered HTML template functions returning strings, shared layout), (6) src/api (JSON endpoints consumed by vanilla-JS front-end enhancements), (7) public/ (static css + js served by the server). AI/pricing/marketplace are interfaces with deterministic MOCK implementations (mock recognizer keyed off filename/seed, mock pricing engine using seeded PriceSnapshots + deterministic math, in-process listing generator, mock marketplace publisher that just marks Listed). TCG-agnostic: a `game` field on Set/Card ('pokemon' initially) and game-specific formatting isolated in a strategy module.
relevant_files: /projects/sandbox/PSA/tsconfig.json (rootDir src, outDir dist, strict, module NodeNext)
directory_structure: PSA/ (git root): package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, README.md; src/{config, db, repositories, services/{interfaces,mock}, server/{middleware,routes}, api, views/{pages,components}, domain(tcg strategy), util}; scripts/{seed.ts}; public/{app.css, app.js, vendor-free assets}; data/ (runtime SQLite, gitignored); dist/ (compiled, gitignored); .agents/tasks/ (this plan).
